tickets.title: Review debt refinance opportunity
tickets.text: Compare keeping the adjustable mortgage after the rate reset (from 4.125% to 7.375%, payment increasing to about $4,920) against a fixed-rate refinance quote. Include payment change, closing costs, break-even period, cash reserve impact, and fit with the household’s retirement contribution goal.

subTasks.title: Gather current and proposed loan details
subTasks.text: Collect current balance, rate type, interest rate, payment, remaining term, prepayment penalties, collateral details, and proposed refinance terms from the client or lender.

subTasks.title: Model cash-flow and break-even impact
subTasks.text: Compare monthly payment change, total interest cost, closing costs, break-even period, and liquidity impact under the current and proposed debt structures.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Summarize pros, cons, planning tradeoffs, open questions, and whether the refinance appears aligned with the client's goals and risk profile.

tickets.evidence: Mira asked Apricot Compass Advisory to compare keeping the adjustable mortgage after the reset against a fixed-rate refinance quote, including payment change, closing costs, break-even period, cash reserve impact, and fit with the household’s retirement contribution goal; the agreed follow-up is due
